definitions.pool P: alive with m0 >= 0.1 (m0: W0's mean trigger importance over the training windows)
definitions.competitors: top 5 tokens by W0's mean next-token probability at the trigger of the held-out windows (target model, no masks), the target excluded
definitions.contrast(c): mean g at Pile ('val', 0, 600) positions whose next token is in c minus mean g over all positions
definitions.N_target: top-|S_on| alive by contrast(target) (E18's J_nat set)
definitions.N_comp: top-|S_down| within P by contrast(the five competitors' union)
definitions.pool null: 20 draws of S_down's size per matrix, uniform over P (S_down's members allowed)
definitions.patterns: at the trigger only, g0 elsewhere: (i) g0; (ii) clip(g0 + s-); (iii) s-'s in-pool values permuted within each matrix's pool, out-of-pool entries kept, clipped, 20 draws
definitions.drop_comp: (competitor mass under (i) - under the pattern) / competitor mass under (i), mean over windows of the CI-masked model's trigger probabilities

control: J_nat = J(S_on, N_target) within 0.02 of E18 (regating_leak.json natural.<task>.s0.J: 0.2844, 0.1546, 0.2432) on the three seed-0 states; runs first, alone; fail: stop.
